items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played with Woody Herman’s band

ctx.x: Yeah. Turner’s Arena, where you could go on Sunday and see a band, but during the week it was basketball and boxing and all that stuff. But on Sunday they would bring in Woody Herman’s band, [Stan] Kenton, like that. You could go and see that one-shot thing. I saw a lot of folks up there too.
What about off of U Street? What about in northeast or southwest? Like Bruce Wall’s. Was that a fixture?
